description: This bill creates protections for First Responders from being overwhelmed by gathering crowds, creates a requirement to publish body cam and other footage of critical incidents, restricts use of ALPR/Flock cameras to protect citizen rights, and protects first responders from abuse while on a scene.
title: Critical Incident Truth and First Responder Protection Act — Will Campbell For TexasCritical Incident Truth and First Responder Protection Act — Version 7
